visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network diagram inside red rectangle. Left side: Input layer with x₁=[1], x₂=[5], Bias=1. Middle: Hidden layer with nodes 3 (O₃), 4 (O₄), 5 (O₅) in yellow circles, plus Bias=1. Right side: Output layer with nodes 6 (O₆), 7 (O₇) in orange circles. Far right: Target column vector [0] t₆, [1] t₇. Green weight labels on input-to-hidden connections. Purple/red weight labels on hidden-to-output connections. All nodes fully connected between adjacent layers.
